prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 red-carpet editorial portrait of a generic adult woman with long voluminous warm-champagne blonde Hollywood waves, pale blue-green eyes, subtle winged liner, luminous natural makeup and glossy rose-pink lips. She wears a floor-length silver-champagne couture gown with intricate black embroidery and a dense white feather fringe, styled with approved jewelry and glossy black nails. Use confident front-facing and three-quarter poses at full-body and medium-close-up distances against an approved event step-and-repeat backdrop. Bright even studio-quality flash creates crisp couture highlights while promotional logos remain softly blurred. Preserve fashion-event realism without reproducing any public-figure likeness.
